title: Chicken Canadian Casserole
description: A creamy casserole dish filled with chicken, velvety sauce and Canadian ingredients, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the Canadian bacon in a skillet until crispy, then set aside.
In a separate pot, combine velvety sauce, milk, and flour. Whisk until smooth and bring to a simmer.
Add shredded cheddar cheese to the sauce and stir until melted.
In a large bowl, combine cooked chicken, Canadian bacon, and sauce mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch casserole dish and top with additional shredded cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
